correctness.rationale: For an r-row basis matrix, the adjacent alternating-form constraints are exactly dependence of consecutive columns. The projective-line/zero transfer has recurrence T[n+2,d]=(1+(q-1)w)T[n+1,d]+(q^d-q)w T[n,d] and initial values 1 and 1+(q^d-1)w; subspace-lattice Möbius inversion and division by |GL_r(q)| give the claimed rational all-rank support law including d=0 and n=0. At fixed q,r>=1 the d=r eigenvalue strictly dominates all d<r; differentiating log of the dominant eigenvalue gives mu=1/2+(q-2)/(2sqrt(q^2+4(q^r-q))) and variance q(q^r-1)/(q^2+4(q^r-q))^(3/2)>0, so characteristic functions prove a CLT. n/r boundary r<=ceil(n/2) is consistent. Independent RREF and transfer checks over q=2,3 corroborate 28 cases, not the infinite limit.
